Predict Slugging Percentage

predict_slg.Rd

Predicts a player's slugging percentage based on statistics from their most recent season.

Usage

predict_slg(
  age,
  xba,
  xslg,
  xwoba,
  bb_pct,
  k_pct,
  iso,
  wrc_plus,
  hr_fb,
  barrel_pct,
  hardhit_pct,
  data = Batting
)

Arguments

age

Player age during their most recent season.

xba

Expected batting average from the most recent season.

xslg

Expected slugging percentage from the most recent season.

xwoba

Expected weighted on-base average from the most recent season.

bb_pct

Walk percentage from the most recent season.

k_pct

Strikeout percentage from the most recent season.

iso

Isolated power from the most recent season.

wrc_plus

Weighted runs from the most recent season.

hr_fb

Home-run-to-fly-ball rate from the most recent season.

barrel_pct

Barrel percentage from the most recent season.

hardhit_pct

Hard-hit percentage from the most recent season.

data

Batting dataset used to fit the projection model.

Value

Predicted slugging percentage for the following season as a numeric value rounded to three decimal places.

Details

Predictors are standardized before the regression model is fitted. The standardized coefficient for expected slugging percentage (xSLG) is constrained to be at least twice as large in absolute value as the next-largest predictor coefficient.

Examples

predict_slg(
  age = 27,
  xba = 0.267,
  xslg = 0.511,
  xwoba = 0.378,
  bb_pct = 12.7,
  k_pct = 24.3,
  iso = 0.271,
  wrc_plus = 149,
  hr_fb = 24.4,
  barrel_pct = 14.3,
  hardhit_pct = 48.6
)
#> [1] 0.463
